title: Longest Consecutive Run
statement:
Find the longest run of consecutive integers `x, x+1, x+2, ..., x+L-1` such that every number of the run appears somewhere in the list. The numbers can appear in any order and repeated values are ignored. Report `L`.

For example, in `100 4 200 1 3 2 101` the numbers `1 2 3 4` form a run of length 4.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. The second line contains `n` integers.

## Output
Print the length of the longest run.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 100000`
- `-10^9 <= a_i <= 10^9`
